name: helper-desk
description: A purple task bar above the prompt that fills as Claude ticks off its to-do list, plus a side pane with one live card and one progress bar per subagent.

bar_color.title: Task bar colour
bar_color.description: The colour of the task bar above the prompt.

animations.title: Animations
animations.description: Moving sparkles, the running crab and the shimmer. Turn off for a still screen and less work for the computer.

auto_open_pane.title: Open the side pane by itself
auto_open_pane.description: Open the Helper Desk pane when Claude starts its first subagent. You can always type /helpers.

nudges.title: Ask Claude to keep a to-do list
nudges.description: Adds a short note to Claude's instructions and a gentle reminder after a few tool calls, so the task bar has something to show. Turn off if you only want the subagent cards.

toasts.title: Pop-ups when a step is done
toasts.description: Show a short pop-up each time a step finishes, and when the whole list is done.

hold_seconds.title: Seconds to keep a finished bar
hold_seconds.description: How long the task bar stays at 100 percent before it goes away. Use 0 to hide it at once.
